dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、そろそろ帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "The graduation party's soon."
dialogues.text: "The graduation party's soon."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
他の部員に挨拶を交わす眞子と、並んで音楽室
をでる。
dialogues.en:
From what I hear listening to the rehearsals, I guess you
guys will do fine.
dialogues.text:
From what I hear listening to the rehearsals, I guess you
guys will do fine.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ行こうか」
dialogues.en:
"But you may have some problems during the love confession
time after the graduation ceremony."
dialogues.text:
"But you may have some problems during the love confession
time after the graduation ceremony."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あと少しで卒パだな」
dialogues.en:
I guess there is really very little chance that boys will
tell her that they like her. Because the word about her
relationship with me has already spread...
dialogues.text:
I guess there is really very little chance that boys will
tell her that they like her. Because the word about her
relationship with me has already spread...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうね」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... I wonder if that girl's already noticed my
relationship with you."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... I wonder if that girl's already noticed my
relationship with you."

dialogues.jp: 練習を聴く限りじゃ、問題はないだろう。
dialogues.en: "She'll find out about it soon."
dialogues.text: "She'll find out about it soon."

dialogues.jp:
「問題があるとしたら、卒業式後の告白タイム
　か」
dialogues.en:
It's only a matter of time. But whether the girl is gonna
give up on Mako is another matter.
dialogues.text:
It's only a matter of time. But whether the girl is gonna
give up on Mako is another matter.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、男からの告白はほとんどないだろう。
俺とのことが、結構うわさになってるし……。
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うーん……まだあの女の子、あきらめてくれ
　ないのかな」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, never mind."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, never mind."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「問題の早苗ちゃんか。まぁ、杉並の話だと結
　構、執着するタイプらしいからな」

それが高じて、ストーカーにならなければいい
けど。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: Mako's holding a white envelope in her hand.
dialogues.text: Mako's holding a white envelope in her hand.

dialogues.jp:
下駄箱の前で靴を取り出していた眞子が、短く
声をあげる。
dialogues.en: "Is that a love letter from the girl?"
dialogues.text: "Is that a love letter from the girl?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の手に、白い便箋が握られていた。
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to read it for you?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to read it for you?"

dialogues.jp: 「例の｛ラブレター／手紙｝か？」
dialogues.en: Looking at her anxious face, I naturally uttered such words.
dialogues.text: Looking at her anxious face, I naturally uttered such words.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en:
"No. Because I think it's not a good idea to show this kind
of thing to someone."
dialogues.text:
"No. Because I think it's not a good idea to show this kind
of thing to someone."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、どうした？」
dialogues.en:
Saying a dutiful thing like she said before, she opens the
envelope and starts to read the letter.
dialogues.text:
Saying a dutiful thing like she said before, she opens the
envelope and starts to read the letter.

dialogues.jp: 杉並が後ろから、ひょっこりと顔を出す。
dialogues.en:
Mako's face is turning to a delighted expression in front of
me, as I watch her with breathless interest.
dialogues.text:
Mako's face is turning to a delighted expression in front of
me, as I watch her with breathless interest.

dialogues.jp:
俺と眞子は声にならない悲鳴を上げて、一瞬、
びくんとすくんでしまった。
dialogues.en: "What does she say?"
dialogues.text: "What does she say?"

dialogues.jp: 「いきなり出てくんなよ。心臓に悪いだろうが」
dialogues.en:
From Mako's expression, I can guess that it's not something
bad.
dialogues.text:
From Mako's expression, I can guess that it's not something
bad.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ふー、小市民的小心者が」
dialogues.en: "Listen, Asakura. She says that she's gonna give up on me!"
dialogues.text: "Listen, Asakura. She says that she's gonna give up on me!"

dialogues.jp:
わけのわからないことを呟きつつ、やれやれと
杉並が首を振る。
dialogues.en:
Coming close to my side as if she's going to hug me, she
shows me the letter.
dialogues.text:
Coming close to my side as if she's going to hug me, she
shows me the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「で、何があったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Wow, you did it!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, you did it!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「例のやつだよ」
dialogues.en:
Hey, you told me that you are not supposed to show someone's
love letter to other people, didn't you?
dialogues.text:
Hey, you told me that you are not supposed to show someone's
love letter to other people, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
I was going to avert my eyes from the letter, but I spotted
one sentence.
dialogues.text:
I was going to avert my eyes from the letter, but I spotted
one sentence.

dialogues.jp:
眞子の顔が心なしか青い。普段の勝気な姿とは
かけ離れていて、少し心配になる。
dialogues.en: "'I hope you'll be very happy together'......"
dialogues.text: "'I hope you'll be very happy together'......"

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: What can I do even if she says so......?
dialogues.text: What can I do even if she says so......?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en:
"Yes. She is saying 'Your happiness is my happiness.' She
seems like a good girl."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. She is saying 'Your happiness is my happiness.' She
seems like a good girl."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず、内容の確認をしないとな」
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp: しかし、眞子は固まったように動かない。
dialogues.en: She falters, her face clouding over.
dialogues.text: She falters, her face clouding over.

dialogues.jp: 「なんなら、俺が代わろうか？」
dialogues.en: "Finally, from tomorrow I can rest."
dialogues.text: "Finally, from tomorrow I can rest."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子が何も言わずに俺の手を握ってくる。
dialogues.en: "What's that?"
dialogues.text: "What's that?"

dialogues.jp:
やはり不安があるのだろう。俺は少しでも元気
づけてやりたくて、握り返してやる。
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.jp: しかし、これじゃ手紙を読むことができんな。
dialogues.en:
"There are only two days left, so I think it'll be okay to
tell them that I have something else to do..."
dialogues.text:
"There are only two days left, so I think it'll be okay to
tell them that I have something else to do..."

dialogues.jp: 「杉並に代わってもらっていいか？」
dialogues.en:
Even if someone says that I'm skipping out on the work, I
can get away with it.
dialogues.text:
Even if someone says that I'm skipping out on the work, I
can get away with it.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん。お願い」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「杉並、頼む」
dialogues.en:
I don't know why, but she doesn't turn her eyes away from
me.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why, but she doesn't turn her eyes away from
me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おう、望むところだ」

まるで果たし状でも受け取ったみたいに、杉並
が手紙を開封して目を通す。
dialogues.en: "But it's a pain in the neck... And I'm bad at getting up."
dialogues.text: "But it's a pain in the neck... And I'm bad at getting up."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふむふむ、そうきたか……」
dialogues.en: I shrug with a sigh.
dialogues.text: I shrug with a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何て書いてあるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "I can still come if you let me show up late."
dialogues.text: "I can still come if you let me show up late."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうやら付き合っていることをまだ疑ってい
　るようだ。もっと証拠を見せないと信用でき
　ない、とさ」
dialogues.en: "As long as you come... I'm fine with that."
dialogues.text: "As long as you come... I'm fine with that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん、俺にも見せてくれ」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「待て、あそこの下駄箱の陰からこちらを監視
　している人影がある」
dialogues.en: I was just joking to make her mad...
dialogues.text: I was just joking to make her mad...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Are you okay? You're acting strange."
dialogues.text: "Are you okay? You're acting strange."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "It's nothing... Let's go."
dialogues.text: "It's nothing... Let's go."

dialogues.jp:
俺と眞子が同時に振り返るが、そんな人影は見
えない。
dialogues.en: She shoves the letter into her pocket and changes her shoes.
dialogues.text: She shoves the letter into her pocket and changes her shoes.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなの、どこにもいないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, hold on."
dialogues.text: "Ah, hold on."

dialogues.jp: 言いながら、杉並が手紙を渡す。
dialogues.en:
I also get out my outdoor shoes from the shoe locker and
change my shoes, and run after her.
dialogues.text:
I also get out my outdoor shoes from the shoe locker and
change my shoes, and run after her.

dialogues.jp: 「どれどれ……」
眞子も横から覗き込む。
dialogues.en: We're walking side by side without talking to each other.
dialogues.text: We're walking side by side without talking to each other.

dialogues.jp: 文面は杉並が言ったとおりの内容だった。
dialogues.en:
Mako's not saying anything, and I missed a cue to talk to
her because I was also caught up in the mood.
dialogues.text:
Mako's not saying anything, and I missed a cue to talk to
her because I was also caught up in the mood.

dialogues.jp: 「……疑り深いな」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「今まで以上に頑張れよ」
dialogues.en:
And we come to the fork in the road, where we have to take
separate paths to go to our homes.
dialogues.text:
And we come to the fork in the road, where we have to take
separate paths to go to our homes.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ、これから大変だな、眞子」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'm going straight home."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'm going straight home."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、うん、そうだね」
眞子が慌てたように応える。
dialogues.en:
Once again, I say goodbye to Mako, who nods cheerlessly, and
I start walking home.
dialogues.text:
Once again, I say goodbye to Mako, who nods cheerlessly, and
I start walking home.

dialogues.jp: （どうしたんだ？　眞子のやつ、慌てて…）
dialogues.en:
I feel uneasy, so I turn around. Mako's still standing in
the middle of the road, the same as she was when I parted
company with her.
dialogues.text:
I feel uneasy, so I turn around. Mako's still standing in
the middle of the road, the same as she was when I parted
company with her.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、俺は先に帰るぞ。朝倉たちはどこで
　見られてるか分からんから、しっかりな」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
When our eyes meet, Mako averts her gaze, and she turns on
her heel and walks off.
dialogues.text:
When our eyes meet, Mako averts her gaze, and she turns on
her heel and walks off.

dialogues.jp: 眞子と顔を見合わせる。
dialogues.en: Hmm...
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.jp: 「俺たちも帰るか」
dialogues.en: What was that?
dialogues.text: What was that?

dialogues.jp:
まあ、元気が出たなら良かった。顔を曇らせる
なんて、眞子には似合わないからな。
dialogues.en:
Puzzling over her reaction, I also turn around and walk off
home.
dialogues.text:
Puzzling over her reaction, I also turn around and walk off
home.

dialogues.jp: ◆ラブレター再び◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
卒パまであと少し、眞子の音楽部の練習も順調
だ。
dialogues.en: "Um, yes."
dialogues.text: "Um, yes."

dialogues.jp:
いつものように一緒に下校する俺たちだが、眞
子の下駄箱の中にまたしてもラブレターが……。
dialogues.en:
I come out of the music room with Mako after she finishes
exchanging goodbyes with the other members.
dialogues.text:
I come out of the music room with Mako after she finishes
exchanging goodbyes with the other members.

dialogues.jp: まだまだ予断を許さない状況のようだ。
dialogues.en: "Okay, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Okay, let's go."
